market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Oil at $108 and CPI tick-up create headwinds, but Dow's 500-pt bounce shows resilience. Expect range-bound equities with energy outperforming. Bitcoin below $77K and gold at 1-month low signal risk-off rotation. Fed likely on hold but hawkish bias. Watch for further Houthi escalation.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI infrastructure capex (Nvidia Australia, Salesforce, monitoring layer) supports tech earnings through 2027. Domestic manufacturing reshoring (Ford, GE, GM) creates multi-year industrial cycle. Energy inflation may moderate if supply stabilizes, but 'higher for longer' rates cap multiple expansion. BRICS realignment adds structural uncertainty to USD-denominated assets.
